api_base.description: The API base for the Lasso guardrail. Default is https://server.lasso.security. Also checks if the `LASSO_API_BASE` environment variable is set.

api_key.description: The API key for the Lasso guardrail. If not provided, the `LASSO_API_KEY` environment variable is checked.

conversation_id.description: The conversation ID for the Lasso guardrail. If not provided, the `LASSO_CONVERSATION_ID` environment variable is checked.

user_id.description: The user ID for the Lasso guardrail. If not provided, the `LASSO_USER_ID` environment variable is checked.
